name: prism-extension
description: Prism — AI Privacy Layer. Chrome extension that redacts personal data before it reaches AI chat apps.

scripts.build: npm run icons && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/fix-dist.mjs && vite build --config vite.ws.config.ts && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.dev: npm run icons && vite build --watch && vite build --watch --config vite.content.config.ts
